svg.title: Proposal and award status path
svg.desc: Four stages. Internal approval ends at Approved, which starts sponsor submission at Unsubmitted. Sponsor submission ends at Accepted, which starts sponsor decision at Pending. Sponsor decision ends at Awarded, which starts the award at In Setup. A Failed attempt is resent. An Invalid or Recalled attempt returns to Unsubmitted and is signed off again. A Withdrawn proposal ends or is revised. A recalled attempt returns to Unsubmitted and is signed off again. If the sponsor loses or rejects a proposal after accepting it, it moves from Pending back to Failed and can be resent. A sponsor can return a proposal as Not Reviewed.
svg.text: Other records, such as modifications and subawards, have their own statuses.
Rejected can come from any point before sending,
by an approval step or the PI, including from Draft
when the sponsor reports nothing in between
fix the package, sign off again
